findings.description: Type mismatch in getUser id comparison: Using strict equality between numeric id and string id causes find to return undefined.
Accessing property on potentially undefined user: After find, user may be undefined; accessing user.name without check leads to runtime error.
Division by zero in calculateAverage: When numbers array is empty, numbers.length is 0, causing division by zero.
Index error in getFirstItem: Accessing items[0] without checking array length may throw error if array empty.
